brotaiPlatform.title: Brotaí Platform
brotaiPlatform.shortDescription: A digital platform designed to simplify access to information, applications, attendance management, and administrative processes for the Brotaí program.
brotaiPlatform.fullDescription: I am part of the collaborative development of a digital platform for Brotaí, a social program run by the City of Niterói that provides free cultural and technical education to local residents. The solution brings together dedicated workflows for participants, instructors, and administrators, centralizing information, applications, classes, attendance records, and administrative activities. My main contribution is focused on front-end development, with additional involvement in back-end development and data modeling.
brotaiPlatform.skills: UX/UI Design, Front-End Development, Figma, React, JavaScript, Node.js, Prisma ORM, SQLite
brotaiPlatform.process: The process began with requirements gathering and the mapping of user profiles, workflows, business rules, and data requirements. The team defined the platform’s features and data model, created responsive interfaces for participants, instructors, and administrators, and integrated the front end with the back end while continuously testing and refining the main workflows.
brotaiPlatform.result: The platform is currently under development and already brings the program’s essential workflows together in a centralized solution. The project is now undergoing validation, refinement, and preparation for deployment.

websiteEkovitra.title: Ekovitra Website
websiteEkovitra.shortDescription: A responsive corporate website designed to showcase sustainable construction solutions and strengthen the company’s digital presence.
websiteEkovitra.fullDescription: I designed and developed the corporate website for Ekovitra, a sustainable construction company based in Manaus, Brazil. The main challenge was to transform technical information about its construction system into a clear, trustworthy, and accessible experience aligned with the brand’s values of innovation and sustainability. My work covered the entire process, from content organization and page architecture to interface design and responsive front-end implementation.
websiteEkovitra.skills: Web Design, Front-End Development, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
websiteEkovitra.process: The process began with organizing the company’s information, developing an understanding of the sustainable construction industry, and analyzing visual and functional references. Based on this research, I defined the page hierarchy and navigation flows, developed the visual direction and responsive layouts, and implemented the interface with React and TypeScript for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
websiteEkovitra.result: The result was a modern, responsive corporate website that presents the company’s solutions clearly and strengthens its digital presence through a visual language aligned with innovation and sustainability.

memorioApp.title: Memório App
memorioApp.shortDescription: A digital journal app designed to help users record emotions, daily reflections, and meaningful memories in one place.
memorioApp.fullDescription: I developed the UX/UI project for Memório during the Digital Design program at FIAP. The goal was to create a digital journal that brought emotional records, personal reflections, and photographs together in a single space. The main challenge was to balance ease of use, clear information organization, and a visual language that conveyed warmth without compromising the clarity of the interface.
memorioApp.process: I researched journal and well-being applications, organized the main features, and defined the information architecture and key user flows. I then developed the visual identity, interface screens, and an interactive prototype in Figma, prioritizing clear hierarchy, simple interactions, and consistency across the different types of entries.
memorioApp.result: The project resulted in a cohesive, interactive prototype that brings emotions, written reflections, and photographs together in an organized and emotionally supportive experience.

helenaDuarteWebsite.title: Helena Duarte Website
helenaDuarteWebsite.shortDescription: A fictional professional website combining editorial design and responsive development for a specialist in Corporate Law and Data Protection.
helenaDuarteWebsite.fullDescription: I created an end-to-end conceptual project for Helena Duarte, a fictional lawyer specializing in Corporate Law and Data Protection. The case study was developed to explore how content strategy, editorial design, and front-end development can work together to build a strong professional presence. The character, portrait, credentials, publications, events, and contact details were created exclusively for the concept.
helenaDuarteWebsite.skills: Web Design, Front-End Development, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
helenaDuarteWebsite.process: I defined the character’s professional positioning, organized the content strategy, and analyzed references from legal websites and editorial design projects. Based on this research, I developed the visual identity, typography, and responsive layouts before implementing the interface with React, TypeScript, and reusable components.
helenaDuarteWebsite.result: The result is a complete case study demonstrating the integration of content, visual identity, user experience, and front-end development in a consistent professional digital presence.

sensenGamesWebsite.title: Sensen Games Website
sensenGamesWebsite.shortDescription: An official, responsive, and bilingual website for a Brazilian indie game studio, created to introduce its games, story, and creative identity to a global audience.
sensenGamesWebsite.fullDescription: I contributed to the collaborative design and development of the official website for Sensen Games, a Brazilian indie game studio. The project was completed during the Bolsa Futuro Digital program, an initiative by Softex in partnership with Brazil’s Ministry of Education, as part of a React-focused Front-End Development course. The goal was to translate the studio’s creative identity into an engaging, responsive experience designed for both Portuguese- and English-speaking audiences.
sensenGamesWebsite.skills: UX/UI Design, Front-End Development, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, i18next, SEO, EmailJS
sensenGamesWebsite.process: The team aligned on the studio’s needs, defined the project scope, organized the content, and distributed responsibilities. I contributed to the creation and refinement of the responsive layouts and to the React implementation, including SPA navigation, internationalization with i18next, SEO optimization, and a contact form integrated with EmailJS.
sensenGamesWebsite.result: The project delivered an official, responsive, and bilingual website that brings together the studio’s story, games, and creative identity in a consistent digital experience developed collaboratively.

natPlusChatbot.title: Nat+ Chatbot
natPlusChatbot.shortDescription: An AI-powered beauty assistant concept designed to make product recommendations more personalized, approachable, and relevant.
natPlusChatbot.fullDescription: As part of a team, I developed Nat+, a conversational AI concept created for the FIAP Challenge 2025 in partnership with Natura. The proposal was to evolve the brand’s existing virtual assistant from a primarily operational tool into a digital beauty consultant capable of understanding users’ preferences, routines, and goals. My contribution focused on UX/UI Design, interaction flows, and the functional prototyping of the chatbot.
natPlusChatbot.process: We analyzed the beauty and skincare customer journey and identified opportunities for personalization. We then mapped usage scenarios and conversational flows, designed the chatbot’s interfaces and interactions in Figma, and implemented a functional prototype in GPTMaker to validate the concept in practice.
natPlusChatbot.result: The result was a functional prototype demonstrating how artificial intelligence, personalization, and conversational design can make product discovery more relevant and engaging.

ekovitraSocialMedia.title: Ekovitra Social Media
ekovitraSocialMedia.shortDescription: Social media content for Ekovitra that makes sustainable construction topics more accessible while reinforcing the brand’s digital identity.
ekovitraSocialMedia.fullDescription: After developing Ekovitra’s corporate website, I extended the brand’s digital presence to social media. The goal was to turn technical topics related to sustainable construction, EPS, and industrialized building systems into clear, engaging, and visually consistent content. I created educational and corporate assets aligned with the identity established for the website, helping communicate the company’s solutions to audiences in the Brazilian state of Amazonas.
ekovitraSocialMedia.skills: Social Media Design, Canva, Video Editing
ekovitraSocialMedia.process: The process began by defining content pillars focused on audience education, frequently asked questions, and the benefits of sustainable construction. Based on research into topics such as EPS, raft foundations, thermal comfort, and industrialized construction, I organized the information, established visual hierarchies, and developed posts, carousels, and video content using accessible language and clear calls to action.
ekovitraSocialMedia.result: The result was a cohesive content system aligned with Ekovitra’s website, making technical subjects easier to understand and strengthening the company’s positioning as a sustainable construction specialist in Amazonas.

paperoSocialMedia.title: Papero Social Media
paperoSocialMedia.shortDescription: Content created to showcase Papero’s personalized stationery products and build a creative, approachable, and consistent digital presence.
paperoSocialMedia.fullDescription: I developed social media content for Papero, my personalized stationery brand. The goal was to present the products in an engaging way, highlight the range of customization options, and communicate the care behind each piece. The project combined product photography, graphic layouts, and informative content to showcase themed collections, party favors, celebration items, and the ordering process.
paperoSocialMedia.skills: Social Media Design, Product Photography, Canva, Video Editing
paperoSocialMedia.process: I structured the content around product showcases, party inspiration, customization options, and guidance on how to place an order. I produced and selected photographs, developed visual compositions, and created static posts, carousels, and short-form videos while maintaining a playful, colorful language consistent with the brand’s handmade personality.
paperoSocialMedia.result: The result was a visually consistent feed bringing together real products, different themes, and purchasing information while clearly presenting Papero’s variety and its thoughtful, personalized character.

nathSocialMedia.title: Nathielli Moreira Social Media
nathSocialMedia.shortDescription: Content for the social media of French teacher Nathielli Moreira, aimed at strengthening her digital presence and engaging potential students.
nathSocialMedia.fullDescription: I developed visual content for the social media of French teacher Nathielli Moreira. The goal was to create a consistent digital presence that conveyed professionalism, approachability, and engagement with potential students. The proposal involved creating posts and stories that reflected the teacher’s identity and facilitated communication with her target audience.
nathSocialMedia.skills: Social Media Design, Canva, Video Editing
nathSocialMedia.process: The process involved analyzing the target audience, reviewing the visual identity, and creating visual content for posts and stories. Graphic elements, typography, and colors were used to reflect the teacher’s personality and facilitate communication with her followers.
nathSocialMedia.result: The result was a stronger and more engaging digital presence for the teacher, with consistent visual content that helped attract and maintain the interest of potential students.

abrigoAnimalSocialMedia.title: Social Media Animal Shelter
abrigoAnimalSocialMedia.shortDescription: A conceptual social media content project created for a fictional animal shelter, focused on responsible adoption, awareness, and welcoming communication.
abrigoAnimalSocialMedia.fullDescription: I created Anjinhos de Patas Animal Shelter as a personal project and Social Media Design study. The goal was to develop a digital presence that could introduce animals available for adoption, share relevant information, and connect the shelter with potential adopters through clear, welcoming, and visually consistent communication. The project included defining the visual direction and creating content for posts and stories.
abrigoAnimalSocialMedia.skills: Social Media Design, Canva, Video Editing
abrigoAnimalSocialMedia.process: The process began by defining the audience, tone of voice, and main content themes, including adoption, animal care, and awareness. I then developed the visual identity for the publications and created assets for posts and stories, combining color, typography, imagery, and graphic elements to convey warmth, trust, and sensitivity.
abrigoAnimalSocialMedia.result: The result was a cohesive conceptual content series adaptable to different formats, demonstrating how design can make an animal shelter’s communication clearer, more human, and more inviting.

appGaleriaArtte.title: Artte Gallery App
appGaleriaArtte.shortDescription: A mobile app prototype designed to make exploring the collection and planning a visit to a fictional art gallery easier.
appGaleriaArtte.fullDescription: I designed the Galeria Artte app as part of the Google UX Design Professional Certificate. The goal was to bring the essential information about a fictional art gallery into a single experience, allowing visitors to explore the collection and artists, check the location and opening hours, and access ticket information. The project also explores features such as QR codes, educational activities, and an artwork purchasing flow.
appGaleriaArtte.skills: UX/UI Design, Information Architecture, Wireframing, Prototyping, Figma
appGaleriaArtte.process: The process began with hand-drawn sketches used to explore the screen structure and main navigation flows. These ideas evolved into wireframes and a low-fidelity prototype that helped organize the content and features. I then developed the visual identity, components, and high-fidelity prototype in Figma, connecting the collection, artists, visit planning, ticketing, and other app flows.
appGaleriaArtte.result: The result was an interactive high-fidelity prototype with a cohesive visual identity and structured flows designed to make discovering artworks, artists, and gallery information clearer, smoother, and more intuitive.

idEkovitra.title: Ekovitra Visual Identity
idEkovitra.shortDescription: A visual identity designed to express innovation, technology, and sustainability in the positioning of an Amazon-based construction company.
idEkovitra.fullDescription: I developed the visual identity for Ekovitra, a sustainable construction company based in the Brazilian state of Amazonas. The goal was to create a contemporary and recognizable brand that communicated its work with innovative building systems and its commitment to more sustainable solutions. This identity became the visual foundation for the company’s other touchpoints, including its corporate website and social media content.
idEkovitra.skills: Brand Design, Visual Identity, Logo Design, Figma, Illustrator
idEkovitra.process: The process began with the brand’s core attributes (innovation, construction, and sustainability) and the search for a simple, versatile symbol. The solution combines the letter “e” with the shape of a leaf, creating a direct connection between Ekovitra and its environmental positioning. From this concept, I developed the logo variations, green and dark color palette, typography, and application rules.
idEkovitra.result: The result was a consistent and flexible visual system, documented in a set of brand guidelines and designed to work across different scales, backgrounds, and formats. The identity connects the company’s institutional materials, website, and social media into one recognizable brand presence.

idVivaInovacoes.title: Viva Inovações Rebranding
idVivaInovacoes.shortDescription: A rebranding project for an education and technology company offering online courses across different subjects and age groups.
idVivaInovacoes.fullDescription: I developed the rebranding for Viva Inovações Educacionais, a company operating at the intersection of education and technology with online courses for diverse audiences. The challenge was to modernize the brand without losing its approachable character, creating an identity that balanced credibility and accessibility with a lighter, more inclusive, and engaging learning experience.
idVivaInovacoes.skills: Brand Design, Rebranding, Visual Identity, Logo Design, Figma, Illustrator
idVivaInovacoes.process: The process began by reviewing the brand’s positioning and values, including practicality, joy, lightness, and inclusion. The kite was retained and refined as the central element, representing movement, discovery, and growth. I then developed new logo proportions and variations, a vibrant color palette, the typographic system, and usage guidance to ensure consistency across digital environments and institutional materials.
idVivaInovacoes.result: The result was a renewed, versatile identity better aligned with digital education. The brand guidelines bring together horizontal and vertical versions, color and monochrome applications, typography, palette, and usage rules, providing a consistent foundation for different courses, audiences, and platforms.

idNucleoSaber.title: Núcleo Saber Visual Identity
idNucleoSaber.shortDescription: A visual identity created for an online education company dedicated to promoting knowledge across different fields and dimensions.
idNucleoSaber.fullDescription: I developed the visual identity for Núcleo Saber, a company specializing in online courses across multiple subject areas. The goal was to represent a brand that brings different fields of knowledge together around a shared core while communicating diversity, organization, trust, and openness to continuous learning.
idNucleoSaber.skills: Brand Design, Visual Identity, Logo Design, Illustrator, Figma
idNucleoSaber.process: The visual concept was built around modular forms suggesting books, pathways, and fields of knowledge connected around a common center. I developed the logo, a multicolored palette representing the variety of courses, the typography, iconography, and a set of supporting shapes designed to organize and differentiate the brand’s communication.
idNucleoSaber.result: The result was a broad and adaptable visual system documented in a set of brand guidelines. The combination of modular structure, vibrant colors, and graphic elements allows the brand to communicate consistently across different subject areas, content types, and educational platforms.

ppt36zero.title: 36Zero Tech Corporate Presentation
ppt36zero.shortDescription: A corporate presentation designed to communicate 36Zero Tech’s solutions and ideas with clarity and visual consistency.
ppt36zero.fullDescription: I designed a corporate presentation for 36Zero Tech to organize and communicate the company’s requested information in a clear, professional, and visually engaging way. The project respected the brand’s existing visual identity and transformed technical and strategic content into a cohesive narrative suited to representing the company and its solutions.
ppt36zero.skills: Presentation Design, Information Design, Visual Hierarchy, Figma
ppt36zero.process: Using the content and direction provided by the client, I structured the presentation flow, established the information hierarchy, and created the layouts in Figma. The proposal was submitted for approval and refined according to the feedback received while maintaining 36Zero Tech’s visual identity throughout the material.
ppt36zero.result: The result was a consistent and easy-to-understand corporate presentation aligned with the client’s expectations, communicating information and ideas more clearly while preserving the company’s visual personality.

cartaoDeVisitaAdvocia.title: Pacheco & Ramos Business Card
cartaoDeVisitaAdvocia.shortDescription: A conceptual project connecting a printed business card to an interactive digital experience through a QR code.
cartaoDeVisitaAdvocia.fullDescription: I created a practice project in Canva for Pacheco & Ramos, a fictional law firm, exploring how a traditional business card could connect to a digital experience. The solution combines a printed card featuring a QR code with an interactive digital card published as a website, bringing the firm’s different contact channels together in one place.
cartaoDeVisitaAdvocia.skills: Graphic Design, Business Card Design, Interactive Design, QR Code, Canva
cartaoDeVisitaAdvocia.process: The process began by defining a visual direction suited to the legal sector, combining a dark palette, gold details, and references associated with the field. I then designed the printed card and added a QR code as a bridge to its digital version, where I organized contact, location, scheduling, website, and LinkedIn links within a simple interactive interface.
cartaoDeVisitaAdvocia.result: The result was an integrated physical and digital solution demonstrating how a traditional printed piece can become more useful by providing quick and organized access to a brand’s main contact channels.
